orgName: Oling Dawn Kerjew Humanitarian and Charities NGO
tagline: Service to humanity, for God and mankind.
description: Oling Dawn Kerjew Humanitarian and Charities NGO is a registered Ugandan NGO. Through its Projects arm it delivers low-cost, non-profit construction of hospitals, schools, roads and bridges, alongside education, healthcare, women's empowerment and community development for underprivileged populations across Uganda — with particular focus on needy children, women and girls, and the families of Uganda's security personnel.
registeredAddress: Adebe Cell, Western Ward, Kamdini Town Council, Oyam South County, Oyam District, Northern Uganda
